quote: The most powerful hope animating this field is the relief of suffering. Families who carry serious inherited conditions… know what it means to watch illness pass from parent to child. Somatic editing offers treatments for people already living with such conditions; heritable editing, its advocates argue, could prevent transmission altogether, sparing future children from diseases that no existing therapy can cure. Some frame this as a straightforward moral duty to heal, continuous with all of medicine.
reason: The briefing develops the optimistic reasoning that, if safe, genome editing can relieve suffering and fulfills a moral duty, presenting it as one perspective without endorsing it.
